glossEn: the quality of having a superior or more favorable position
note: the quality of having a superior or more favorable position。指自身条件上就比别的好。线索：优势通常与「本身/相较他人」搭配。the advantages of a bilingual education 是这事物本身的条件。
(tennis) first point scored after deuce。平分后的先得一分。对考研无价值，但确实是英语义位，保留。

glossEn: benefit resulting from some event or action
note: benefit resulting from some event or action。强调「由某事件/行动带来的好处」，与 s1 的「固有优势」相对。线索：benefit / advantage 后接 of + 某事。one advantage of moving abroad is warmer weather.
give an advantage to。动词义，线索：宾语是人。The funding advantages small labs.
